newsitem.title: USA: American Insured Series 85 sets monthly div.
newsitem.headline: American Insured Series 85 sets monthly div.

text.p: American Insured Mortgage Investors Series 85 LP said it declared a monthly distribution of $0.16. The latest distribution includes $0.11 per unit for regular cash flow and $0.05 per unit as a return of capital and gains due to the receipt of proceeds from the assignment of a mortgage.
The distribution is payable May 1 to unitholders of record on February 28.
The prior distribution paid was $2.52 for an estimated return of capital and $0.07 for the limited partnership distribution.
